goal: density, Tg and bulk modulus for polysulfone (bisphenol-A, Udel) (achiral), stereo_r2

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PSFO carries no ff_justification_doi; 'pcff' is the class prior and the strongest support on file is the class's own first cited source. PCFF via EMC. Sun1994 (CFF93/PCFF) is the FF's general origin; no class-specific PCFF MD validation paper for polysulfone has been located. A dedicated literature search found no PCFF- or COMPASS-vs-experiment density/Tg number for polysulfone, polyethersulfone, or a small-molecule diaryl-sulfone analog. PolyJarvis's own measured -4.0% to -4.3% density deficit and +2-8% Tg overestimate are internal measurements only, neither literature-corroborated nor contradicted. No field-override recommended; this is a genuine open validation gap.
evidence.citation: Hayashi, Y. et al. RadonPy: Automated Physical Property Calculation using All-atom Classical Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Polymer Informatics. npj Comput. Mater. 2022, 8, 222.

entanglement_dp_advisory.detail: entanglement MW Me=2380 g/mol for member 'PSU' (Mark 2007 Ch.25) / repeat-unit MW 442.5 g/mol -> DP@Me=5 -- reported for context only, not an acceptance criterion for bulk_modulus: entanglement Me governs shear/viscoelastic properties (plateau modulus, reptation), not the isothermal bulk modulus, which is an EOS/local-packing quantity. Establish chain-length convergence of density/K instead (a small DP sweep confirming both plateau) rather than requiring DP>=DP@Me.

nchain_below_production_minimum.detail: nchain=10 is below the advisory PCFF production minimum 20. Its source ("Bejagam 2020") has no copy in this repo and no verified DOI, so the claim is unchecked; nchain>=10 (Wang 2021, verified) IS met, and Hayashi 2022 (RadonPy) ran nchain=10 across 1,077 polymers. Raising nchain to 20 at a fixed system-mass floor would halve per-chain MW (worse chain-length bias); raising it at fixed DP doubles cost for no criterion this module can state. Reported, not applied -- the L>=2*Rg finite-size gate (a separate, already-mechanized check) is the binding constraint on nchain; supply a nchain is now a pure function of the system-mass floor.

RIGID_BACKBONE_CHAIN_LENGTH_BIAS.detail: backbone classified stiff (backbone_rotatable_fraction=0.37, backbone_ring_fraction=0.80, longest_rigid_backbone_run=4 atoms -> stiff). The cell is sized by total system mass (Wang 2021), which for this heavy repeat unit (442.5 g/mol) gives DP=12 -- short chains. No chain-length-convergence study exists for rigid aromatic backbones, and no Kuhn-length value was supplied for this SMILES, so the residual chain-length bias on Tg is UNQUANTIFIED. Reported, not gated: a DP floor here would be the retired Fox-Flory rule, whose cited source (Patrone 2016) prescribes no floor and studies crosslinked epoxies with no degree of polymerization at all.
